summary: Computes a normalized ratio: invokes two virtual methods on this (function pointers stored at vtable offsets +32 and +24), forms the range v3 = v2 - v1 as a double, returns 0.0 when the range is non-positive, otherwise returns (double)this[56] / v3 where this[56] is the dword at byte offset 0xE0. Interpreted as a normalized position or progress fraction.

operations.description: Invoke the virtual method whose function pointer is stored at vtable offset +32 (field obj+0x20) on this; store the int result in v2.
Invoke the virtual method whose function pointer is stored at vtable offset +24 (field obj+0x18) on this; its int result is the lower operand.
Form the range v3 = (double)(v2 - v1) between the two virtual-method results.
When v3 <= 0.0 the range is non-positive and the function returns 0.0.
Return 0.0 when the computed range is non-positive.
Compute the fraction (double)this[56] / v3 using the dword at byte offset 0xE0 as the numerator.
